apply_weight_norm_module: apply weight normalization to a module parameter using WeightNorm.apply with name and dim arguments
create_weight_norm_linear: create a weight normalized linear module using the weight_norm convenience function
remove_weight_norm_module: remove weight normalization reparameterization from a module using remove_weight_norm
compute_weight_norm_weight: compute the reparameterized weight from magnitude and direction tensors using WeightNorm.compute_weight
remove_weight_norm_manual: remove weight normalization from a module manually using WeightNorm.remove method
